title: Conjugated topologically confined composite electrolytes for robust high-voltage and high-temperature semi-solid-state lithium metal batteries
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2026, 19,384-396
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE04892C, Paper
Wang Xu, Yongbiao Mu, Yaoyu Yin, Anjun Hu, Yuanjian Li, Jian Wang, Qi Liu, Jianping Long, Lin Zeng, Shimou Chen
This work proposes a conjugated topologically confined composite electrolyte, promoting the formation of an anion-dominated solvation structure and LiF/Li3N-rich interphases that suppress lithium dendrites and cathode degradation.
